posts.text: Objections to Islamic ideology center on its core texts. The Quran (e.g. 9:5, 9:29) and Hadith endorse fighting non-believers until submission, death for apostasy, and hudud punishments like stoning and amputation under Sharia. Women get half inheritance and testimony value of men; men may take multiple wives. Non-Muslims face historical dhimmi rules or conversion pressure.
